'''Zeb's Hideout''' was a [[Color|green]] [[cargo container]] at [[Chopper Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Atollon]] where [[Garazeb Orrelios]], [[Phoenix Cell]]'s [[Chief of Security]] relaxed. It was located on an outgrowth of the [[Atollon Coral Mesa]] outside the main area of the base, between the [[Atollon command center]] and repair pads. Inside the container, Orrelios stored some of his personal effects and attached to its side was a shelf below a makeshift shade that he used as both bunk and workspace. He also kept a [[receiver]] at the hideout and used it to play inspirational<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> rock<ref name="Zeb Rock">[[Star Wars Rebels: Season Two (Original Soundtrack)|''Star Wars Rebels: Season Two'' Original Soundtrack]]</ref> [[music]].<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> The side of the cargo container was decorated with a poster of the [[Lasat]] [[BoscoFace]] and other illustrations, including a [[stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor|helmet]] and the head of a [[Rodian]].<ref name="The Mystery of Chopper Base">{{Rebels|The Mystery of Chopper Base}}</ref>

Members of [[Phoenix Cell]] avoided disturbing Orrelios while he relaxed at his hideout unless there was an emergency and only close friends would join him if he was resting or watching the [[sunset]].<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> Prior to Orrelios' fellow [[Spectres]], [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Mission to Malachor]], Bridger joined him at the hideout while he listened to music and watched the sunset. The pair discussed the upcoming mission and Bridger shared his fears that he wouldn't return. Orrelios comforted his friend, reassured him that he would come back, and joked that in the time he would be away, Phoenix Cell would have already overthrown the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="The Mystery of Chopper Base" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeb's Hideout first appeared in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[The Mystery of Chopper Base]]."<ref name="The Mystery of Chopper Base" /> It was later identified in the [[2018]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] sourcebook, ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''.<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" />
